_comment: Every passkey and gate in one place. Previously each was a string literal
inside the page it guarded, so changing one meant hunting through HTML.
READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING IT: these are client-side gates in a public
repository. Anyone can read this file, or the page source, and learn every
key here. They keep an admin tool from being opened by accident or by a
casual visitor — they are NOT access control, and nothing genuinely
sensitive should sit behind them. Real protection needs a server, or the
Firebase accounts already being wired up in dge/js/user-auth.js.
Change a key here and it takes effect on next load. Anyone already holding
a session flag stays in until their tab closes; bump sessionFlag alongside
the key to evict them immediately.

superadmin.label: Super admin
superadmin.note: Also satisfied by localStorage is_superadmin === 'true', which the account system sets.

audioadmin.label: Audio admin
audioadmin.note: Separate key so audio work can be delegated without handing over the super-admin key.

capture.label: Capture and convert
capture.note: No passkey by design — these push straight to GitHub, so they require localStorage is_superadmin === 'true', set only by the account system.

genieasr.label: Genie ASR recorder
genieasr.note: Its own key on purpose, not a reuse of audioadmin or superadmin/capture. audio.html documents its audioadmin token as reaching ONLY the separate bhumandala-audio-data repo, 'never the main content repo' — this tool is different: it writes to Tribhuvanachar/bhumandala itself (the main repo), and only ever to the genie-asr-audio-seed branch, which that branch's own README says to keep out of main. That's a bigger blast radius than audioadmin (a different repo entirely) and a narrower one than superadmin/capture (which reach main), so it gets a gate of its own rather than borrowing either. A fine-grained GitHub token can be scoped to just this one repo, but GitHub has no per-branch token scope — so even a well-scoped token could still write to main if this page had a bug. The branch restriction is enforced only by this page's own code hardcoding genie-asr-audio-seed, not by the token.
